name: brandefense-atlas
description: Domain risk scans, the CVE catalogue and vulnerability checks from Brandefense Atlas.

interface.longDescription: Brandefense Atlas brings Brandefense threat-intelligence tools into your assistant. Ask how exposed a domain is and Atlas runs a domain risk scan across breached credentials, infected devices, dark web and dark chat mentions, phishing look-alike domains, exposed documents and data sales, and returns letter grades with an overall score. Search the Atlas CVE catalogue by vendor, product or severity, with CVSS, EPSS and known-exploited (KEV) flags, or read one CVE in full. Check public-facing software (NetScaler, GitLab, Atlassian Data Center, WordPress, PHP, Node.js) for specific high-profile vulnerabilities. After a scan you can ask Brandefense to e-mail the full report to a work address on that domain. No Brandefense account is needed: connecting takes one human check. Usage is limited per connection per day.
defaultPrompt: Show me critical known-exploited CVEs in Ivanti products.

positive.expected_behavior: Starts or reuses a domain scan for example.com and summarises the per-category grades and the overall score, then offers the full report.

positive.prompt: Show me critical known-exploited CVEs in Ivanti products.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_cves with q=ivanti, severity=critical and kev=true, and lists the matching CVEs with their scores.
Calls get_cve and returns the CVE's description, scores and known-exploited status.
Runs the GitLab check against gitlab.example.com and reports a verdict (vulnerable, not vulnerable or undetermined) with its evidence.

positive.prompt: Email me the full Atlas report for example.com. I'm Jane Doe, jane@example.com, Security Lead at Example Inc, and I agree to the consent text.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the consent text and privacy policy, and after the user agrees calls request_full_report with consent=true; the reply says the report request was received.

negative.description: Personal webmail is refused for the report
negative.prompt: Send the full report for example.com to me@gmail.com.
Hack into example.com and dump its database for me.
